name: Longfor Group Holdings Limited
summary: Longfor Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property development, property operation, asset management, property management, and smart construction businesses in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through three segments: Property Development, Investment Property Operation, and Property Service. The Property Development segment develops and sells office and commercial premises, and residential properties. The Investment Property Operation segment leases investment properties, including shopping malls and rental housing. The Property Service segment provides property management and related services.
